title: fix(core): eliminate unsafe as any casts in live preview modules
body:
Replace all s any/: any casts in live-preview-table.ts, live-preview-diag.ts, live-preview.ts, live-preview-renderers.ts, and editor.ts with proper TypeScript types.

**Type safety**
- Parameter types: 
ode: any ? MdastNode/TableCell/PhrasingContent
- Widget method access: (widget as any) ? public methods
- Dynamic import: (globalThis as any) ? NexusDiagGlobal interface
- Mermaid import: (mod as any) ? typed cast with \default\ in mod guard
- MermaidAPI: added missing initialize signature
- Internal callbacks: removed unnecessary : any (type inference from context)
- Widened getNodeSourceOffsets to accept PositionalNode instead of requiring double cast

**Cross-session column width persistence**
- Stable storage key by separator line hash + document offset
- localStorage with 7-day TTL, automatic eviction (max 50 entries)
- Auto-trim/pad width array on column add/delete
- Double-click resize handle to reset columns to auto width

**Testing**
- 2 new regression tests (empty cells, inline HTML hitting default branch)
- All typechecks pass (core, react, vue), 517 tests pass, build OK.

commits_at_first_review.message: fix(core): eliminate unsafe as any casts in live preview modules
